lines.text: Creepy fact storytime. Lights off. Nobody leaves the bed.
Can the night-light stay on? For legal reasons.
I'm staying on. I have seen him sleep without me.
Creepy fact number one. You can always see your own nose.
Your brain just chooses to ignore it.
Why would you tell me that?
Now it's just sitting in the middle of my face.
It has always been there, Desmond. That is where they keep it.
Creepy fact number two. Your tongue never knows where to rest.
Stop it. Stop it right now.
He is going to be like this until Thursday.
Okay. Real ones now. Creepy facts about this apartment.
Creepy fact. We live on the top floor.
Yeah. So?
So who vacuums upstairs at three in the morning?
The roof. The roof is vacuuming.
I have heard it. It does the corners.
Creepy fact. Someone has been eating your yogurt.
My labeled yogurt?
Every single cup. And they put the lid back on.
That is the scariest thing ever said in this room.
Creepy fact. The empty cups are lined up behind the couch. In size order.
They're all the same size!
Exactly. Think about it.
I want my mom.
Your mom gave us the bunny.
Clementine has nothing to do with this. Look at her. She's asleep.
Is she, though.
Creepy facts about you, Desmond.
Me? I am not creepy. I am a delight.
Creepy fact. You say good night to the fridge.
The fridge works hard. It deserves respect.
Creepy fact. He says good morning to the toaster. It never answers.
It's shy!
Creepy fact. Last night you talked in your sleep for twenty minutes.
What did I say?
You said, I will not be returning the shopping cart.
That doesn't sound like me.
You said it with your whole chest. I flickered.
My turn. Nobody remembers buying the night-light.
I came with the apartment. Like the smell.
What smell?
Exactly. You stopped noticing it. That is the creepy part.
Creepy fact. Bunnies can sleep with their eyes open.
Clementine can talk?
Creepy fact. I was never asleep. I heard every secret.
How long have you been able to talk?
Since the yogurt.
You ate my yogurt?
You labeled it Desmond. I assumed that was the flavor.
I told you. Size order.
Wait. The vacuuming at three in the morning?
It's a hobby. Don't ask how I get up there.
How do you get up there?
I said don't ask.
Last creepy fact. Clementine is on the lease.
She pays rent?
More than you, darling. I do voiceovers.
I'm sleeping in the hallway.
Creepy fact. The hallway light is my cousin. He is worse.
Good night, fridge.
